# 1 Enoch Chapter 73 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn-astr (Aramaic) | **Section:** Astronomical Book (Book of Luminaries)

---

**73:1** And-after this-law I-saw another-law dealing-with the-smaller luminary, which-is named the-Moon.

**73:2** Her-circuit is-like the-circuit of-the-heaven. And-her-chariot in-which she-rides, at-the-darkness thereof, is-driven-by the-wind, and-light is-given to-her in-[definite]-measure.

**73:3** And-on every-month of-her-going-out and-of-her-coming-in, she-does-not shine equally: because her-light is-not equal; but-she-appears different in-the-various parts of-her-circuit.

**73:4** And-in-the-first month she-rises in-the-greater light, and-in-the-first month at-her-appointed-time she-rises with-the-sun in-the-portal through-which the-sun-rises, and-she-has-light from-the-sun for-a-half [of] a-seventh part, and-her-globe is-one-seventh part and-one-half of-one-seventh part.

**73:5** She-sets with-the-sun, and-when the-sun-rises she-rises with-it and-receives half-of-one part of-light; and-on-that-night in-the-beginning of-her-morning at-the-commencement of-the-lunar day she-sets with-the-sun, and-is-invisible that-night with-the-fourteen-portions and-a-half [in-darkness].

**73:6** And-she rises on-that-day with-exactly a-seventh part, and-comes-out and-recedes from-the-rising of-the-sun; and-in-her-remaining-days she-becomes bright in-the-remaining thirteen parts.

**73:7** And-I-saw another-course and-law for-her: by-which she-accomplishes-her-monthly-circuit according-to this-law.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Chapter 73 introduces the lunar law. The moon's light is described in fractions of a "seventh part" — 14 parts total for full moon, waxing by half a seventh (= 1/14) per day. 4QEn-astr preserves Aramaic fragments.*
